segments.title: Drops land in the dock
segments.body: With tabs on top, a pinned tab dragged in the dock lands where you drop it. With favorites in the dock, it used to snap back to the end.

segments.title: ⌘S slides the tabs away
segments.body: With tabs on top, ⌘S slides the strip up and out of the window, and the page keeps its margins. It used to vanish in one frame and jump.

segments.title: Your shortcut, everywhere
segments.body: Set Close Tab to ⌃⇧W and the command bar says ⌃⇧W, and so do menus and tooltips. They used to keep showing ⌘W.

segments.title: Netflix opens in WebKit
segments.body: Netflix, Disney+, Max and other streaming sites open in WebKit from the first visit, where their video plays. The mark on the icon shows the engine.

segments.title: Private, and it says so
segments.body: A private window opens with an Incognito heading, a private search field and a note on what gets deleted when you close it.

segments.title: Arc's frame in Arc's layout
segments.body: With the address bar in the sidebar, the page sits in Arc's 10 pt frame, so the window is easier to grab. It used to stay at 7 pt.

segments.title: Close a tab, stay put
segments.body: Close the selected tab in a pinned group and the sidebar stays where it is. It used to scroll off toward the tab picked next.
